name: @opensourceclaw/openclaw-claw-mem
description: Claw Memory System - Local-First OpenClaw Plugin (Plugin Slots Enabled)

scripts.build: tsc && cp dist/claw_mem_plugin/index.js dist/ && sed -i '' 's|require("../src/|require("./src/|g' dist/index.js && for d in dist/src dist/claw_mem_plugin; do mkdir -p $d && cp openclaw.plugin.json $d/; done && cp openclaw.plugin.json dist/

author: Peter Cheng
